definitions.gloss: pest control; prevention and extermination of pests or diseases
definitions.explanation: The combined activities of preventing and eliminating harmful insects, animals, weeds, or plant diseases. A standard term in agriculture, forestry, and public health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防除|ぼうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{防除|ぼうじょ}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Pest control methods that do not use pesticides are attracting attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧{松枯|まつが}れ{病|びょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防除|ぼうじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}い{止|と}める→食い止める：06384_kuitomeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The entire community is working together on pine wilt disease control, but it is difficult to halt the spread of damage.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (prevent, defend) and {除|じょ} (remove, eliminate). Covers both prevention (⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧) and elimination ({除|じょ}) in a single term. Used across agriculture, forestry, and public health.

USAGE:
Frequently encountered in agricultural extension materials, municipal pest control notices, and environmental policy. Can refer to controlling insects, plant diseases, invasive species, or weeds. Often modified by the target: {害虫防除|がいちゅうぼうじょ} (insect pest control), {病害虫防除|びょうがいちゅうぼうじょ} (pest and disease control).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧{防除|ぼうじょ}: insect pest control
- {防除|ぼうじょ}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: pest control measures
- {防除|ぼうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out pest control
- {生物的|せいぶつてき}{防除|ぼうじょ}: biological pest control

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: extermination — focuses on eliminating pests that are already present, without the preventive aspect
- ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: disinfection, sterilization — killing pathogens on surfaces or in environments
- ⟦{除草|じょそう}→除草：18648_josou⟧: weeding — specifically removing unwanted plants
- {害虫対策|がいちゅうたいさく}: pest countermeasures — a broader, less technical term for dealing with pest problems
